canonical.name: A punctured explicitly constructed acyclic smooth 6-dimensional handlebody gives a homology cobordism that is not an h-cobordism
canonical.support: Two 1-handles and two framed 2-handles realise the words a²b⁻³ and a²(b⁻¹a)⁻⁵. The integral incidence matrix has determinant one; the explicit permutations a=(12)(34), b=(135) give a nontrivial fundamental-group image. Puncturing a coordinate 6-disk and applying the locally available Mayer–Vietoris, universal coefficient, fully relative duality and van Kampen suppliers proves both end inclusions are integral homology isomorphisms while S⁵→W fails to be a homotopy equivalence. No Mazur datum is a premise.
